title: Modern GEODATA DXF scale-estimation method domain
scope: For GEODATA object versions 2 and 3, DXF group 95 now writes only documented values 1 through 4. The model default and reset value are 1 (no scale adjustment), so default modern output uses a valid value. Version 1 remains on its distinct map and accepts this modern-field default while refusing nondefault modern-only values. DXF input parsing remains tolerant.

normativeSources.title: Autodesk GEODATA (DXF)
normativeSources.group95: 1 none; 2 user-specified scale factor; 3 grid scale at reference point; 4 prismoidal.

normativeSources.title: Open Design Alliance DbGeoData API reference
normativeSources.enum: ScaleEstimationMethod starts at kScaleEstMethodUnity = 1, then user-defined, reference-point and prismoidal methods in order.

implementation.behavior: Modern DXF output rejects group-95 values below 1 or above 4 during preflight. DRW_GeoData default construction/reset now selects documented method 1. The v1 output guard treats that value as the default modern-only field and continues rejecting other values so v1 data is not silently dropped.

regressionControl.coverage: For v2 and v3 in ASCII and Binary, values -1, 0 and 5 preserve a prior output prefix and caller identity; corrected same-writer retries use valid values 1 or 4 and typed readback verifies the method. The default modern writer emits group 95 value 1. Existing v1 and v2/v3 roundtrip controls still pass.
regressionControl.fixturePolicy: All controls are authored locally in memory; no DWG/DXF fixture was added.

nonClaims: No physical producer or native geospatial consumer was qualified.
This does not qualify GEODATA ownership, whole-document graph closure, map projection behavior or DWG encoding semantics.
